title: What is Hope Harbor
content: Hope Harbor is a nonprofit-focused website experience for a class project. It highlights support services, child safety priorities, program impact, and donor transparency.

title: Organization mission and services
content: The organization supports vulnerable children through safe housing, care services, and long-term reintegration support. The About page is the best place to understand mission and programs.

title: Where the organization operates
content: The website shares public information about where the organization operates at a high level. For safety reasons, specific shelter and safehouse locations are not publicly shared.

title: How long Hope Harbor has operated
content: Organization background and timeline details are provided on the About page when publicly available.

title: Registered nonprofit and compliance
content: Questions about nonprofit status and formal registration should be answered using public organization information and direct contact support when a formal confirmation is required.

title: Transparency and accountability
content: The organization communicates trust through financial reporting, accountability practices, and impact updates. Donors can review public impact information and contact the team for additional clarification.

title: About children served
content: Public information may describe broad service populations and support pathways. Private case details, identities, or sensitive trauma specifics are not publicly disclosed.

title: Children counts and outcomes
content: When public metrics are available, the site can share high-level impact outcomes. Individual child records, real-time internal counts, and identifiable case details are not shared.

title: What a safehouse is
content: A safehouse is a protected care setting designed to provide immediate safety and support services. Operational details shared publicly stay high-level to protect children and staff.

title: Safehouse location privacy
content: Specific safehouse locations are not publicly disclosed for safety and privacy reasons.

title: Safehouse expansion and capacity
content: Expansion conversations generally focus on growing safe, sustainable support capacity for children while maintaining confidentiality and security.

title: How to donate
content: Donors can use the donor flow to make contributions, including recurring options when enabled. Donation paths are available through the donor login page.

title: Donation methods and tax questions
content: Donation logistics and tax-related questions should be confirmed through the contact page so donors receive the most accurate and current guidance.

title: Where donations go
content: Public impact and transparency content explains how support is directed toward care, safety, and program operations. For detailed allocation questions, donors can contact the team.

title: Sponsorship and directed giving
content: Requests for specific child sponsorship or location-specific funding must follow safety and policy rules. Visitors should use the contact page for approved giving options.

title: Donor updates and communication
content: Donors who want updates can use the contact page to ask about communication options and reporting practices.

title: Corporate and organizational giving
content: Companies and organizations can inquire about giving and partnerships through the contact page.

title: Volunteering and involvement
content: People who want to support beyond donating can use the contact page to ask about approved involvement opportunities.

title: Site visits and safehouse visits
content: Safehouse visits are restricted for safety and privacy reasons. Any approved engagement process should be coordinated directly through official channels.

title: Partnerships and advocacy
content: Partnership and awareness opportunities can be discussed through the contact page.

title: Contact page guidance
content: For direct help, use the contact page. It is the best route for detailed, policy-specific, or case-specific questions.

title: Privacy and safety commitment
content: Resident safety is prioritized through privacy-first practices. Identifying resident information and secure location details are not publicly shared.
